confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge, not a live price or listing check. Restaurant, café and beer anchors are moderate confidence; hostel and hotel anchors are lower confidence given volatile July lakeside lodging demand and few registered budget options. Cocktail and wine are weak-knowledge anchors set relative to beer (about 2.25x and 1.2x). USD values rest on an assumed euro-dollar rate that was not looked up. FX is from RBA web search results without a direct page read; one search result carried an unrelated formatting instruction, which was ignored.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: a busy Alpine lakeside tourist town at peak July season, priced above typical provincial French cities and below Paris, with restaurant prices benchmarked to comparable French resort and lakeside towns and lodging to summer demand in the Savoy and Haute-Savoie region.
